content: ...AI Solutions Engineer, you bridge the gap between rapid AI-assisted product delivery and scalable, governed platform engineering. You will spend roughly 50% of your time taking high-value internal use cases from business needs to reliable, production-grade applications, and 50% of your time collaborating with the AI Platform Lead on our shared internal applications platform, DevOps workflows, and governance guardrails. You think ahead: instead of solving problems with brittle one-off fixes, you turn recurring needs into clean, reusable platform capabilities and help guide our Junior AI Solutions Engineers to do the same. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. You will own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy: how we assess and manage supplier risk, which suppliers we develop as long-term partners, and where we vertically integrate through partnerships, licensing, joint ventures or acquisitions. You will also define and own our supplier portal landscape, the digital backbone of how we collaborate with suppliers. Finally, you will own how ICEYE meets local content requirements, supporting our local entities as they select and onboard in-country suppliers. This role is for a leader who moves comfortably between the boardroom and the engineering bench: credible with executives, investors and partners, and equally credible with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and supplier engineers. SUPO, where required) WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS: As a Customer Success Operations Specialist, you’ll run the operating rhythm behind ICEYE’s Missions Customer Success model. Missions delivers sovereign SAR satellite programs to governments worldwide, and Customer Success stays with these customers from go-live through operations, renewal and expansion. Program Managers and Customer Success Managers in each market own the relationships; you own what keeps them running smoothly: the governance calendar, pre-reads, meeting minutes, action registers and follow-up. You’ll make sure every internal review and customer meeting happens on time, is well prepared, ends with clear decisions, and that every action is closed. Within six months, you will independently drive the cadence across all target accounts. This ensures our customers stay satisfied, building the baseline for a long-lasting relationship. Nice to haves: - Experience in a scale-up or high-growth company. - Experience in complex, contract-driven industries, for example revenue recognised over time. - Experience with ERP and consolidation tools, and with close automation. ... key position responsible for cooperating with customs agencies and carriers to ensure seamless import/export clearance and timely deliveries. You will manage end-to-end inbound and outbound freight flows, execute international trade compliance (including ITAR, EAR, and dual-use export controls), coordinate customs brokerage services, and oversee shipping documentation. You will work closely with Procurement, Production Planning, Quality, and external logistics partners to ensure all shipments arrive on schedule while adhering to compliance and budget requirements. What you will do - Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, including air, sea, and road freight forwarding, customs clearance, and carrier coordination. - Execute full compliance with international trade regulations, dual-use items, ITAR, and EAR export controls. - Manage relationships and operational workflows with external customs agencies (such as Customs Support Group/Rusak Business Services) and freight forwarders (such as Gebrüder Weiss). - Prepare, verify, and archive essential shipping and customs documentation (e.g., AWB, SAD/ZC429, commercial invoices, DSK declarations). - Ensure proper tariff classification (HS/CN codes), valuation, and origin determination for satellite components and specialized aerospace equipment. - Monitor freight costs, duty payments, and customs duty guarantees, driving cost optimization and efficiency in transport activities. - Coordinate specialized handling, shock-sensitive packaging, and transport requirements for high-value space hardware in accordance with AS9100 and ECSS standards. - Mitigate logistics risks, supply disruptions, and customs delays through proactive tracking and contingency planning.
